title: Rainbow Island Adventure
moral: Helping others and sharing makes adventures special.

story: Captain Rosie sailed her ship with her crew to find the Lost Treasure of Rainbow Island. A strong storm arrived with wind and rain, making the journey difficult for Rosie and her crew. On the island, Rosie and her crew found Sam who was lost and helped him safely. They followed the map and found a treasure chest filled with jewels and a book. Rosie and her crew sailed home, proud of their adventure and kindness.
